request.query: finite set from finite image and finite fibers

items.name: Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) {s : Set α}, (f '' s).Finite → (∀ x ∈ f '' s, (s ∩ f ⁻¹' {x}).Finite) → s.Finite

items.name: Set.fintypeOfFintypeImage
items.type:
{α : Type u} →
  {β : Type v} →
    (s : Set α) → {f : α → β} → {g : β → Option α} → Function.IsPartialInv f g → [Fintype ↑(f '' s)] → Fintype ↑s

items.name: Set.finite_range
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {ι : Sort w} (f : ι → α) [Finite ι], (Set.range f).Finite

items.name: Set.Finite.preimage'
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : α → β} {s : Set β}, s.Finite → (∀ b ∈ s, (f ⁻¹' {b}).Finite) → (f ⁻¹' s).Finite

items.name: Finite.Set.finite_range
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {ι : Sort w} (f : ι → α) [Finite ι], Finite ↑(Set.range f)

items.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite.finite_preimage_singleton
items.type:
∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite f] (y : ↥Y),
  (⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f.base) ⁻¹' {y}).Finite

items.name: Set.Finite.image
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {s : Set α} (f : α → β), s.Finite → (f '' s).Finite

items.name: Finset.card_preimage_eq_sum_card_image_eq
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {f : ι → M} {s : Finset M},
  (∀ b ∈ s, {a | f a = b}.Finite) → Nat.card ↑(f ⁻¹' ↑s) = ∑ b ∈ s, Nat.card { a // f a = b }
